sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 90. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies despair for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 25 Cost.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +60
